name: moon
description: A balanced crescent moon with a clean circular concavity.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The crescent preserves the recognizable lunar silhouette as an intentional circular exception to the rounded rectangular object baseline. A radius-8 outer arc and a radius-12 concave inner arc share the original horn endpoints. At the owner request for a fuller crescent, the inner arc is flatter than the previous radius-9 revision, adding approximately 1.38 units of body thickness at the crescent midpoint. The outer contour, both horn endpoints and Regular 1.70 stroke weight are retained. One closed path avoids doubled edges. Native centerline bounds remain x/y=4.35424869..19.64575131; Regular 1.70 gives equal opposite visible margins of 3.50424869. Rounded stroke joins soften both horns. Static draft awaiting owner review.
